meta.title: SylvaLearn — Personalised Learning Assistant
meta.description: Mobile-first educational productivity web app combining calm study focus with document-based learning, adaptive quiz mastery, and modular AI tutor interfaces.

textbooks.title: Textbook & Document Library
textbooks.subtitle: Select local PDF study materials. Handled entirely on your local device.
textbooks.privacyBody: Selected documents are parsed locally for file metadata; no files are uploaded to external cloud servers. The current prototype includes curated passages for Campbell Biology, Stewart Calculus, and Modern History. When connected to the native Android ExecuTorch container, the full on-device PDF extractor and vector chunker will index any custom uploaded file automatically.

textbooks.localText: Document "{{fileName}}" was selected safely on your local device. In this web prototype, passages are demonstrated. When the native Android ExecuTorch container is attached, on-device OCR/PDF parsing indexes the full document text offline.
textbooks.inspectorNote: In full on-device deployment, ExecuTorch extracts full vector embeddings directly from your PDF pages. Below are the active sample reference excerpts.

tip1.title: The 25-Minute Focus Interval
tip1.desc: Sustained attention drops after 30-40 minutes. Study for 25 minutes, then stand up and disconnect for 5 minutes.

tip2.title: The Feynman Technique
tip2.desc: Explain the concept out loud as if teaching a 12-year-old. Wherever you stumble or use jargon is your actual knowledge gap.

tip3.title: Interleaving Subjects
tip3.desc: Mix two different subjects in one evening (e.g., Biology then History) rather than cramming one subject for 4 hours.

tip4.title: Dual Coding with Diagrams
tip4.desc: Convert textbook paragraphs into a hand-drawn diagram. Connecting visual and verbal pathways doubles recall durability.
